# R5.26 — Isolated replay and fresh-execution admission cards

## Summary

Lands the §6.3 **Replay / optional R1**, **Fresh / optional R2|R3**
and **Independent replication/transfer** admission cards inside
`hh-bundle` (the recipient-procedure owner, beside `closure.rs`):
`admit_replay(&Decoded, run_id, &ReplayAttempt) →
Result<AdmissionCard, BundleError>` and
`admit_fresh(&Decoded, run_id, &FreshClaim) →
Result<AdmissionCard, BundleError>` — records-in/records-out,
nothing executes; the live replay driver stays in `hh-embed`.
`admit_replay` walks `inputs` → `prefix` → `suffix` → `counters` →
`decisions` → `rederivation` verbatim: the copy's prefix must be
envelope-exact against an original whose hash/chain recomputes,
only `lifecycle.replay.*` markers may append, the card **recounts**
attempted provider/effect dispatches itself (declared counts must
agree; any nonzero attempt fails even when the transport blocked
it), replayed decision/assembly sequences compare exactly, and R1
rederives the full required derived set from authoritative bytes.
`admit_fresh` refuses `unfunded`/retired-model/`not_fresh`/
charging-attribution, every level-scoped required input, and
`not_independent` through the landed `compute_independence`, then
evaluates `native_basis` through `levels::derive` and `arms`
(n ≥ k ≥ 2 — one fresh demo awards no level). Cards stay separate:
`replay-card/1`/`fresh-card/1` with `procedure`/`level` members;
`prerequisites`/`resources`/`counters`/`independence` never fold
into `verdict`; `idp/1`-sealed like `ReproReport`. No
`hh replicate`/`hh bug-bundle` command (§6.3 — recipe/CLI owner is
R5.28).

## What changed

- `crates/hh-bundle/src/cards.rs` — the two owner interfaces plus
  `AdmissionCard`/`ReplayAttempt`/`FreshClaim`/`Isolation`/
  `RederivedObject`/`FreshLevel`/`CardVerdict` and the closed
  `cards::code` refusal set.
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/error.rs` — `BundleError::CardRefused
  {code, detail}` variant (one typed refusal vocabulary).
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/lib.rs` — module + exports.
- `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_26.rs` — 20-case battery over a
  scratch-Store producer → `assemble` → `Decoded` fixture; the
  disposable copy is the decoded prefix plus chain-minted
  marker/attempt envelopes (see AC table).
- ADR-0404 (landing record), coverage dated note, BL-47 home, run
  ledger.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,823 changed source/test lines vs the ≤750 trigger (~2.4×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`7f0fbe76` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.26-split-review.md`):
the partition packet binds both admission cards into one owner
unit with no written contingency; the replay-vs-fresh seam is real
but undocumented (documentary test); AC-1's pair-separation
property and AC-2's single numbered negative span both cards; the
shared `AdmissionCard`/rig is load-bearing; leg (a) alone still
exceeds the trigger.
